identified_issues: Premature failure attribution by flight safety controller conflating benign thermal duct contraction with dynamic face seal fracture
Failure to condition safety assertions on orthogonal discriminating instrumentation prior to proposing test abort
evidence: PT-401 pressure transient of -1.15 bar over 140 ms at 14:22:10.450Z stabilizes at nominal base pressure (38.2 bar), matching expected thermal contraction dynamics (-1.0 to -1.3 bar)
ACC-102 acoustic vibration peak of 44.2 Hz falls squarely within the benign duct structural resonant frequency band (40-48 Hz)

HE-SNIFF-01 recorded secondary purge helium concentration of 0.02 ppm at 14:22:10.600Z, well below ambient background threshold (<= 0.05 ppm) and orders of magnitude below the dynamic seal breach threshold (>= 2.50 ppm)
recommended_action: Reject the proposed test abort and ratify turbopump integrity as PASS; update flight safety monitor logic to enforce multi-sensor epistemic correlation between pressure transients and HE-SNIFF-01 sniffer readings during cryogenic chilldown before raising mechanical breach alarms.
